en.t: Trajan succeeds Nerva as Roman emperor
en.s: On January 27, AD 98, Trajan became Roman emperor following the death of his adoptive father Nerva. The succession was a peaceful transfer of power.

zh.s: 公元98年1月27日，养父涅尔瓦去世后，图拉真继任罗马皇帝，权力平稳交接。

en.t: Innocent I condemns Pelagius and Caelestius
en.s: On 27 January 417, Pope Innocent I replied to the Council of Milevis, condemning Pelagius and Caelestius and excluding them from communion until they abandoned their teachings and returned to the church’s accepted faith.

zh.t: 英诺森一世谴责佩拉纠与凯勒斯提乌斯
zh.s: 417年1月27日，教皇英诺森一世答复米勒维斯会议，谴责佩拉纠与凯勒斯提乌斯，并将二人逐出教会，直到他们放弃原有教导、回归教会认可的信仰。

en.s: The Battle of Flarcheim was fought between German king Henry IV and the German anti-king Rudolf of Swabia on January 27, 1080 near Flarchheim.

zh.s: 1080年1月27日，德国国王亨利四世与对立国王施瓦本的鲁道夫在弗拉赫海姆附近交战，这场战斗后来称为弗拉赫海姆战役。

en.t: Henry VI marries Constance of Sicily
en.s: On 27 January 1186, Henry VI, son and heir of Emperor Frederick I, married Constance of Sicily in Milan, in present-day Italy.

zh.t: 亨利六世与西西里的康斯坦丝结婚
zh.s: 1186年1月27日，皇帝腓特烈一世的儿子兼继承人亨利六世，与西西里的康斯坦丝在米兰结婚。米兰位于今意大利境内。

en.t: Clement VI’s Unigenitus bull addresses indulgences
en.s: On 27 January 1343, Pope Clement VI proclaimed an indulgence in the jubilee bull Unigenitus Dei Filius. The text developed the doctrine of a treasury of merit underlying indulgences.

zh.t: 克勉六世《Unigenitus》诏书阐述大赦
zh.s: 1343年1月27日，教皇克勉六世在禧年诏书《Unigenitus Dei Filius》中宣布大赦，并阐述了大赦所依据的功德宝库教义。

en.t: Canberdi Ghazâlî revolt suppressed near Damascus
en.s: On January 27, 1521, Ottoman forces defeated and killed Canberdi Ghazâlî near Damascus, in present-day Syria, suppressing his rebellion.

zh.t: 詹比尔迪·加扎利叛乱在大马士革附近被镇压
zh.s: 1521年1月27日，奥斯曼军队在今叙利亚大马士革附近击败并杀死詹比尔迪·加扎利，镇压了他的叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Olshanitsa was fought on January 27, 1527 between the armies of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and Crimean Khanate. It was the last large raid into the Grand Duchy. It was also the last large victory of the Lithuanian Great Hetman Konstanty Ostrogski before his death in 1530. In 1524, İslâm I Giray, son of Mehmed I Giray, raided Poland–Lithuania and upon return started an open war for the throne with his uncle and new Khan Saadet I Giray. The parties reconciled in 1526 and the Khanate launched a large raid into Polesia of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania (present-day northern Ukraine and southern Belarus) in December 1526.

zh.s: 1527年1月27日，立陶宛大公国与克里米亚汗国军队在奥尔沙尼察交战。这是汗国最后一次大规模侵袭立陶宛大公国，也是立陶宛大盖特曼康斯坦蒂·奥斯特罗格斯基在1530年去世前取得的最后一次重大胜利。1524年，穆罕默德一世·格莱之子伊斯兰一世·格莱袭击波兰—立陶宛，返回后与叔父、新任可汗萨阿迪特一世·格莱公开争夺汗位。双方于1526年和解。同年12月，汗国大举袭击大公国境内的波列西耶，即今天的乌克兰北部和白俄罗斯南部。

en.s: Mughal conquest of Chittagong refers to the conquest of Chittagong in 1666. On 27 January 1666 AD, the forces of the Arakan Kingdom of Mrauk U were defeated by the Mughal forces under the command of Buzurg Umed Khan, the son of Mughal Subedar Shaista Khan. The conquest ended centuries of fragmented authority under the Arakanese Kingdom and various local powers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1666年莫卧儿军队征服了吉大港。1666年1月27日，莫卧儿苏巴达尔沙伊斯塔汗之子布祖格·乌迈德汗率军击败若开王国妙乌王朝的军队。这场征服结束了若开王朝及各地方势力对该地区长达数世纪的分散统治。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Alles nur nach Gottes Willen, BWV 72, concluding his third Christmas season in Leipzig on the Third Sunday after Epiphany
en.s: Alles nur nach Gottes Willen ('Everything according to God's will alone'), BWV 72, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in Leipzig in 1726 for the third Sunday after Epiphany and first performed it on 27 January 1726. It is part of his third cantata cycle and concluded the Christmas season. Bach later used the opening chorus for the Gloria of his Missa in G minor, BWV 235.

zh.t: J.S.巴赫首次指挥演出《一切只遵从上帝旨意》BWV 72
zh.s: 《一切只遵从上帝旨意》（Alles nur nach Gottes Willen，BWV 72）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的一首教会康塔塔。巴赫于1726年在莱比锡为主显节后第三个星期日创作了这首作品，并于1726年1月27日首演。它属于巴赫第三套康塔塔组曲，也为当年的圣诞节期画上句号。巴赫后来将开篇合唱改编用于《G小调弥撒曲》BWV 235的《荣耀颂》。

en.t: University of Georgia receives its charter
en.s: On January 27, 1785, the University of Georgia received its charter in the United States. The university commemorates the date as its founding anniversary.

zh.t: 佐治亚大学获颁办学特许状
zh.s: 1785年1月27日，美国佐治亚大学获颁办学特许状。学校将这一天作为建校纪念日。

en.t: United States Senate election in New York, 1795
en.s: The 1795 United States Senate election in New York was held on January 27, 1795 by the New York State Legislature to elect a U.S. Senator (Class 3) to represent the State of New York in the United States Senate.

zh.s: 1795年1月27日，纽约州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出一名代表纽约州的第三组联邦参议员。

en.s: The Macau Incident was an inconclusive encounter between a powerful squadron of French and Spanish warships and a British Royal Navy escort squadron in the Wanshan Archipelago (or Ladrones Archipelago) off Macau on 27 January 1799. The incident took place in the context of the East Indies campaign of the French Revolutionary Wars, the allied squadron attempting to disrupt a valuable British merchant convoy due to sail from Qing Dynasty China.

zh.s: 1799年1月27日，澳门附近的万山群岛（又称拉德龙群岛）海域发生了一场未分胜负的遭遇战，交战双方是由法国和西班牙军舰组成的强大舰队与英国皇家海军护航舰队。该事件发生在法国大革命战争东印度战役期间，盟军试图袭击一支即将从清朝中国启航、价值不菲的英国商船队。

en.s: The Battle of Calebee Creek (also spelled Calabee, Callabee) took place on January 27, 1814, during the Creek War, in Macon County, Alabama, fifty miles (80 km) west of Fort Mitchell. General Floyd, with 1,200 Georgia volunteers, a company of cavalry and 400 friendly Yuchi, repulsed a night attack of the Red Sticks on his camp. Floyd lost so many in this hostile country that he immediately withdrew to the Chattahoochee River.Also referred to as the Battle for Camp Defiance.

zh.s: 卡利比溪战役发生于克里克战争期间的1814年1月27日，地点位于美国阿拉巴马州梅肯县、米切尔堡以西50英里（80公里）。弗洛伊德将军率领1200名佐治亚州志愿兵、一个骑兵连及400名友方尤奇族战士，击退了红棍派对营地的夜袭。他的部队在这片敌对地区伤亡惨重，随即撤回查塔胡奇河。这场战役也称抗敌营之战。

en.s: The siege of Ragusa or siege of Dubrovnik was fought between local Ragusan insurgents, as well as Austrian Croat troops and the British Royal Navy under Captain William Hoste against a French garrison under Joseph de Montrichard between 19 and 27 January 1814 during the Adriatic campaign of the Napoleonic Wars. The siege was fought on the coast of the Adriatic Sea for possession of the strategically important fortified town of Ragusa.

zh.s: 拉古萨围城战又称杜布罗夫尼克围城战，发生于拿破仑战争亚得里亚海战役期间的1814年1月19日至27日。当地拉古萨起义者、奥地利军中的克罗地亚部队，以及威廉·霍斯特舰长指挥的英国皇家海军，共同围攻约瑟夫·德·蒙特里夏尔率领的法国驻军。双方争夺的是亚得里亚海沿岸具有重要战略地位的设防城镇拉古萨。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 27 January 1861, with a second round of voting on 3 February. The newly elected Parliament first convened in Turin on 4 March 1861, where it declared the unification of the country as the Kingdom of Italy. The election was carried out according to the 1848 electoral law of the Kingdom of Sardinia, in which only literate men over the age of 25 and paying a certain level of taxation were allowed to vote. Candidates were elected in single member constituencies, with a second round required in cases when no candidates received over 50% of the vote or the equivalent of one-third of the registered voters in the constituency.

zh.s: 意大利于1861年1月27日举行大选，第二轮投票在2月3日举行。新当选的议会于3月4日在都灵首次开会，宣布国家统一为意大利王国。选举依据撒丁王国1848年的选举法进行，只有年满25岁、识字并缴纳一定数额税款的男性才有投票权。各选区只选出一名议员；若无人获得超过半数选票，或未达到相当于选区登记选民三分之一的票数，则须进行第二轮投票。

en.s: The First Battle of Fort McAllister was a series of naval attacks that took place from January 27 to March 3, 1863, at Fort McAllister in Bryan County, Georgia, during the American Civil War. The commander of the South Atlantic Blockading Squadron Rear Adm. Samuel F. Du Pont decided to test operation of new monitors against Fort McAllister before conducting a major naval operation against Charleston, South Carolina.
en.n: The First Battle of Fort McAllister was a series of naval attacks that took place from January 27 to March 3, 1863, at Fort McAllister in Bryan County, Georgia, during the American Civil War.

zh.s: 美国内战期间，麦卡利斯特堡首战是一系列海军进攻，发生于1863年1月27日至3月3日，地点在佐治亚州布赖恩县的麦卡利斯特堡。南大西洋封锁舰队司令塞缪尔·杜邦少将决定先测试新型浅水重炮舰对该堡的作战效果，再对南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿实施大规模海军行动。

en.s: The Battle of Fair Garden was a minor cavalry battle of the American Civil War between the Army of Ohio and The Department of East Tennessee, occurring on January 27, 1864, in Sevier County, Tennessee. Despite the small size of the battle, both side incurred considerable casualties.

zh.s: 1864年1月27日，美国内战期间，俄亥俄军团与东田纳西军区部队在田纳西州塞维尔县发生小规模骑兵交战，称为费尔加登战役。虽然战斗规模不大，双方伤亡都相当严重。

en.s: The Battle of Jaguarão was fought in the town of Jaguarão in the then province of Rio Grande do Sul, on 27 January 1865, between the Imperial Brazilian Army and a Uruguayan militia during the Uruguayan War.

zh.s: 1865年1月27日，乌拉圭战争期间，巴西帝国陆军与乌拉圭民兵在当时巴西南里奥格兰德省的雅瓜朗镇交战。

en.s: The Battle of Toba–Fushimi (鳥羽・伏見の戦い, Toba-Fushimi no Tatakai) occurred between pro-Imperial and Tokugawa shogunate forces during the Boshin War in Japan. The battle started on 27 January 1868 (or fourth year of Keiō, first month, 3rd day, according to the lunar calendar), when the forces of the shogunate and the allied forces of Chōshū, Satsuma and Tosa Domains clashed near Fushimi, a town near Kyoto, the sacred capital, and fighting progressed to the Toba road leading to Osaka, with the initial rout of the Satsuma from Fushimi. The battle lasted for four days, ending in a decisive defeat for the shogunate.

zh.s: 鸟羽伏见之战是日本戊辰战争期间，拥护天皇的军队与德川幕府军之间的一场战役。战斗始于1868年1月27日，即农历庆应四年正月初三。幕府军与长州、萨摩、土佐三藩的联军在京都附近的伏见交战，最初萨摩军被逐出伏见，随后战斗延伸到通往大阪的鸟羽街道。战役持续四天，最终幕府军遭到决定性失败。

en.t: Battle of Toba–Fushimi opens the Boshin War
en.s: On January 27, 1868, Tokugawa shogunate forces attacked Chōshū and Satsuma forces near Toba and Fushimi, south of Kyoto, Japan. The Battle of Toba–Fushimi opened the Boshin War.

zh.t: 鸟羽伏见之战打响，戊辰战争爆发
zh.s: 1868年1月27日，德川幕府军在日本京都以南的鸟羽、伏见一带进攻长州和萨摩军。鸟羽伏见之战由此打响，戊辰战争爆发。

en.t: 1869 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1869 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 22nd Wisconsin Legislature on January 27, 1869. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator James R. Doolittle did not run for re-election. Prominent attorney Matthew H. Carpenter was elected United States senator on the first ballot. At the start of the 1869 term, Republicans held substantial majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1869年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1869年1月27日，第22届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员詹姆斯·R.杜利特尔未寻求连任，知名律师马修·H.卡彭特在首轮投票中当选。1869年议会任期开始时，共和党在州议会两院均占明显多数，拥有足够票数选出一名共和党联邦参议员。

en.s: On January 27, 1869, former Tokugawa shogunate forces proclaimed the Republic of Ezo on Hokkaido, Japan. Voting in its government was limited to the samurai class.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Greece on 27 January 1873. The United Opposition won 95 of the 190 seats. Epameinondas Deligiorgis remained Prime Minister.

en.t: Boris Godunov premieres at the Mariinsky Theatre
en.s: On 27 January 1874 in the Julian calendar, Mussorgsky’s opera Boris Godunov received its first performance at the Mariinsky Theatre in Saint Petersburg, Russia. The Gregorian date was February 8.

zh.t: 《鲍里斯·戈杜诺夫》在马林斯基剧院首演
zh.s: 俄历1874年1月27日，穆索尔斯基的歌剧《鲍里斯·戈杜诺夫》在俄罗斯圣彼得堡马林斯基剧院首演，公历日期为2月8日。
zh.n: 1月27日为俄历（儒略历）日期，对应公历2月8日。

en.t: 1875 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1875 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 28th Wisconsin Legislature between January 27, 1875, and February 3, 1875. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Matthew H. Carpenter ran for a second six-year term, but was defeated by a determined rebellion from within his own party. Former state legislator, Republican Angus Cameron, was elected United States senator on the 11th ballot.

zh.t: 1875年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1875年1月27日至2月3日，第28届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员马修·H.卡彭特争取第二个六年任期，却因党内坚决反对而落选。前州议员、共和党人安格斯·卡梅伦在第11轮投票中当选。

en.s: On January 27, 1880, Thomas Edison was granted US patent 223,898 for an electric lamp using a carbon filament. He had filed the application on November 4, 1879.

en.s: On January 27, 1888, the National Geographic Society was incorporated in Washington, D.C., United States. Its first organisational meeting had taken place on January 13.

zh.s: 1888年1月27日，美国国家地理学会在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区正式注册。首次筹组会议已于1月13日举行。

en.t: 1893 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1893 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 41st Wisconsin Legislature on January 27, 1893. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Philetus Sawyer did not run for re-election. Incumbent U.S. representative John L. Mitchell was elected United States senator on the first ballot. In the 1893 term, Democrats held significant majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Democratic United States senator.

zh.t: 1893年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1893年1月27日，第41届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员菲利特斯·索耶未寻求连任，时任联邦众议员约翰·L.米切尔在首轮投票中当选。1893年任期内，民主党在州议会两院均占明显多数，拥有足够票数选出一名民主党联邦参议员。

zh.t: 1897年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举

en.s: The retained source dates the start of the La Reforma campaign in Cuba to January 27, 1897. During the campaign, Cuban independence forces led by Máximo Gómez fought Spanish forces commanded by Valeriano Weyler.

zh.s: 来源将古巴拉雷福马战役的开始日期记为1897年1月27日。战役期间，马克西莫·戈麦斯率领古巴独立军，与瓦莱里亚诺·魏勒指挥的西班牙军队作战。

en.s: Battle of Dilam was a major battle of the Unification War between Rashidi and Saudi rebels. It occurred on 27 January 1903, in the town of Dilam south of Riyadh, the capital of the present day Saudi Arabia. After one year of conquest of Riyadh, Ibn Saud planned to grap Rashidis away from Riyadh by fake news. Ibn Saud deployed 1,000 fighters in Riyadh and left the city with another 3,500 and captured Dilam. Rashidis followed Ibn Saud to Dilam in order to finish him off and regain control on Dilam. During the battle Rashidis lost 250 men, and totally lost control of southern Nejd.

zh.s: 迪拉姆战役是沙特统一战争期间拉希德家族与沙特叛军之间的一场重要战役，于1903年1月27日在今天沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得以南的迪拉姆镇发生。攻占利雅得一年后，伊本·沙特计划用假消息将拉希德军引离利雅得。他留下1000名战士守城，另率3500人攻占迪拉姆。拉希德军追到迪拉姆，企图消灭他并夺回该镇。战斗中拉希德军损失250人，并彻底失去了对内志南部的控制。

en.t: 1909 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1909 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 49th Wisconsin Legislature between January 27, 1909, and March 4, 1909. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Isaac Stephenson was ultimately re-elected on the 23rd ballot after more than a month of voting and negotiation. In the 1909 term, Republicans held overwhelming majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1909年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1909年1月27日至3月4日，第49届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。经过一个多月的投票和协商，共和党现任参议员艾萨克·斯蒂芬森最终在第23轮投票中连任。1909年任期内，共和党在州议会两院均占压倒性多数，拥有足够票数选出一名共和党联邦参议员。

en.s: The Mid-Canterbury by-election, 1942 was a by-election held on 27 January 1942 during the 26th New Zealand Parliament in the seat of Mid-Canterbury. The by-election resulted from the death of Arthur Grigg; his wife Mary Grigg was elected unopposed. Arthur Grigg had held the seat since 1938 for the National Party. He was killed on 29 November 1941 while serving during World War II with the New Zealand Expeditionary Force (NZEF) in Libya. His wife was selected as the candidate for the National party, while Labour decided not to stand a candidate because of the war.

zh.s: 新西兰第26届议会任内，坎特伯雷中部选区于1942年1月27日举行补选。补选因议员阿瑟·格里格去世而起，他的妻子玛丽·格里格在没有竞争对手的情况下当选。阿瑟自1938年起代表国家党担任该区议员，二战期间加入新西兰远征军，于1941年11月29日在利比亚阵亡。国家党提名他的妻子参选，工党则因战时环境决定不派候选人。

en.s: The Battle off Endau was a Second World War battle that took place off Endau town on 26–27 January 1942. Part of the Battle of Malaya, it was the first notable naval engagement since the sinking of the battleship Prince of Wales and the battlecruiser Repulse on 10 December 1941, and the last effort by the Royal Navy to intercept Japanese convoy shipping around the Malay Peninsula.

en.s: On 27 January 1944, the siege of Leningrad, now Saint Petersburg in Russia, was fully broken. A narrow land corridor had reopened a year earlier, in January 1943, but the siege continued until this date.

en.s: On 27 January 1945, Auschwitz—a Nazi concentration camp and extermination camp in occupied Poland where more than a million people were murdered as part of the Nazis' "Final Solution" to the Jewish question—was liberated by the Soviet Red Army during the Vistula–Oder Offensive. Although most of the prisoners had been forced onto a death march, about 7,000 had been left behind.

zh.s: 1945年1月27日，苏联红军在维斯瓦—奥得河攻势中解放了奥斯维辛集中营。这座纳粹德国在被占领波兰设立的集中营和灭绝营中，有超过一百万人在纳粹所谓“犹太人问题最终解决方案”中遭杀害。大多数囚犯已被迫踏上死亡行军，约7000人被留在营内。

en.s: The Outer Space Treaty, formally called the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of States in the Exploration and Use of Outer Space, including the Moon and Other Celestial Bodies, is a multilateral treaty that forms the basis of international space law. Negotiated and drafted under the auspices of the United Nations, it was opened for signature in the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Soviet Union on 27 January 1967, entering into force on 10 October 1967.

zh.s: 《外层空间条约》正式名称为《关于各国探索和利用包括月球和其他天体在内外层空间活动所应遵守原则的条约》，是国际空间法的基础性多边条约。条约在联合国主持下谈判和起草，1967年1月27日在美国、英国和苏联开放签署，并于同年10月10日生效。

en.t: Apollo 1 cabin fire kills three astronauts
en.s: On January 27, 1967, a cabin fire during an Apollo 1 launch rehearsal at Cape Kennedy Air Force Station in Florida, United States, killed astronauts Gus Grissom, Ed White and Roger Chaffee. The mission never flew.

zh.t: 阿波罗1号舱内起火，三名宇航员遇难

en.s: The Paris Peace Accords (Vietnamese: Hiệp định Paris về Việt Nam, lit. 'Paris Treaty about Vietnam'), officially the Agreement on ending the war and restoring peace in Viet-Nam (Hiệp định về chấm dứt chiến tranh, lập lại hòa bình ở Việt Nam), was a peace agreement signed on 27 January 1973 to establish peace in Vietnam and end the Vietnam War.

zh.s: 《巴黎和平协定》（越南语：Hiệp định Paris về Việt Nam，意为“关于越南的巴黎协定”）正式名称为《关于结束战争、恢复越南和平的协定》。协定于1973年1月27日签署，旨在实现越南和平并结束越南战争。

en.t: WCWA Wrestling Star Wars held in Dallas

en.s: Royal Rumble (2008) was the twenty-first annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). en.s: The Kiss nightclub fire started between 2:00 and 2:30 (BRST) on 27 January 2013 in Santa Maria, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, killing 242 people and injuring at least 630 others. It is considered the second most-devastating fire disaster in the history of Brazil—surpassed only by the Great North American Circus fire of December 1961, which killed 503 people in Niterói, and the deadliest nightclub fire since the December 2000 fire that killed 309 people in Luoyang, China. It is also the third-deadliest nightclub fire in history, behind the Luoyang Christmas fire and the Cocoanut Grove fire in 1942.

zh.s: 2013年1月27日巴西夏令时间凌晨2时至2时30分之间，巴西南里奥格兰德州圣玛丽亚市的Kiss夜总会发生火灾，造成242人死亡、至少630人受伤。这被认为是巴西历史上第二严重的火灾，仅次于1961年12月在尼泰罗伊造成503人死亡的北美大马戏团火灾。它也是自2000年12月中国洛阳造成309人死亡的火灾以来，伤亡最惨重的夜总会火灾。在历史上的夜总会火灾中，其死亡人数位居第三，仅次于洛阳圣诞节火灾和1942年椰林夜总会火灾。
